title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog (Project Subset)

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: FastAPI multipart form data boundary parser denial of service
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multipart form parsing in python multipart / fastapi allows remote exploitation.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade to fixed version or apply mitigating proxy headers.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: urllib3 Request body not stripped on cross-origin redirects
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: urllib3 does not remove request body on 303 redirect leading to sensitive data exposure.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: py ReDoS vulnerability in svn log parser
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Regular expression denial of service in svnwc subpackage.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Remove dependency on deprecated py library.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitHub Actions command injection in changed-files
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Command injection vulnerability when processing pull request branch names.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Pin action to immutable full commit SHA.
